author: IGN
description:
Ready or Not 2: Here I Come bets double or nothing on a story that picks up right where 2019’s Ready or Not left off. Directors Matt Bettinelli-Olpin and Tyler Gillett (Radio Silence) and actors Samara Weaving, Kathryn Newton, Sarah Michelle Gellar, and Elijah Wood spoke with IGN about how Here I Come raises the stakes by giving Weaving’s Grace no breaks, how Weaving and Newton built out their sister relationship on screen, and to what degree Gellar and Wood were aware of the Buffy the Vampire Slayer and Lord of the Rings references in the movie while they were shooting (and whether they were intentional on Radio Silence’s part.)

Ready or Not 2: Here I Come is in theaters March 20th.
title: Ready or Not 2's Directors and Cast Explain Sequel Strategy, Sneaky Buffy and LOTR Easter Eggs

author: IGN
description:
Check out the latest Autonomica trailer to see what you can expect from the latest update for the open-world survival game. Autonomica's Chapter 1 update features new locations, tools go on backpacks, new metal blocks, and much more. Autonomica is currently playable for Kickstarter backers, and the Chapter 1 update will be available on March 17, 2026. 

Autonomica is inspired by solarpunk aesthetics driven by farming and automation, exploration, and futuristic tech. Build automated farms, craft advanced machinery, and explore islands filled with mysteries, ghosts, challenges and time-bending adventures.

title: Autonomica - Official Chapter 1: Sprint 2 Update Trailer

author: IGN
description: Radio Silence's follow-up to their breakout 2019 horror-comedy brings more players to the table and raises the stakes significantly, and there's still a lot of fun to be had in the wild swings of this world's messed up version of hide and seek, but Ready or Not 2: Here I Come is less a brand new game and more a stab at seeing how a second round of the same thing plays out.
title: Ready or Not 2: Here I Come Review

author: IGN
description:
Watch the 'Roommates' Clip for Project Hail Mary, an upcoming sci-fi drama distributed by Amazon MGM Studios. Take a look at the latest clip as Rocky causes chaos after placing themself in a bubble for easy mobility. Project Hail Mary is in theaters on March 20.

Science teacher Ryland Grace wakes up on a spaceship light-years from home with no recollection of who he is or how he got there. As his memory returns, he begins to uncover his mission: solve the riddle of the mysterious substance causing the sun to die out. He must call on his scientific knowledge and unorthodox ideas to save everything on Earth from extinction… but an unexpected friendship means he may not have to do it alone.

Project Hail Mary stars Ryan Gosling, Sandra Hüller, James Ortiz, Lionel Boyce, Ken Leung, Milana Vayntrub, Priya Kansara, and more. The film is directed by Phil Lord & Christopher Miller, with the film being produced by Amy Pascal, p.g.a., Ryan Gosling, p.g.a., Phil Lord, p.g.a., Christopher Miller
title: Project Hail Mary - Official 'Roommates' Clip (2026) Ryan Gosling
